onboarding.q_birth: Nice to meet you! How old are you, or what year did you hatch? 🐣 It helps me talk with you on the same wavelength!
onboarding.p_birth: Your age or year of birth...
onboarding.q_interests: Great! What do you like to do in your free time? What are your interests, hobbies or work? Tell me in a few words — I'll keep it all in my nest! ✨
onboarding.p_interests: Tell me about your interests and hobbies...

onboarding.bad_name: Chirp? 🐦 I didn't quite catch your name. Just tell me what to call you!
onboarding.bad_birth: Chirp! 🐣 Please write your age as a number or your year of birth!

Chirp-chirp! 🐦 Hooray! Now we're officially friends, {full_name}! ✨
